        让你的 Yii2 应用性能提升 10-100 倍！本教程将教你如何在 yii2-app-basic 中快速集成 yii2-swoole。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="yii2-swoole-快速入门">Yii2-Swoole 快速入门</h1>
<p>让你的 Yii2 应用性能提升 10-100 倍！本教程将教你如何在 yii2-app-basic 中快速集成 yii2-swoole。</p>
<h2 id="为什么使用-yii2-swoole">为什么使用 yii2-swoole？</h2>
<ul>
<li>⚡ 比 PHP-FPM 快 10-100 倍</li>
<li>🔄 数据库和 Redis 连接池自动管理</li>
<li>🚀 协程并发处理请求</li>
<li>💻 代码几乎不需要修改</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="系统要求">系统要求</h2>
<ul>
<li>PHP &gt;= 8.1</li>
<li>Swoole &gt;= 6.0</li>
<li>Yii2 &gt;= 2.0</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="安装-swoole">安装 Swoole</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">pecl install swoole
</code></pre>
<p>在 <code>php.ini</code> 中添加：</p>
<pre><code class="language-ini">extension=swoole.so
</code></pre>
<p>验证：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">php --ri swoole
</code></pre>
<h2 id="快速开始">快速开始</h2>
<h3 id="1-安装扩展">1. 安装扩展</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">composer require dacheng-php/yii2-swoole
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-创建配置文件">2. 创建配置文件</h3>
<p>创建 <code>config/swoole.php</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">&lt;?php

return [
    'bootstrap' =&gt; [
        [
            'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Bootstrap::class,
            'componentId' =&gt; 'swooleHttpServer',
            'memoryLimit' =&gt; '2G',
        ],
    ],
    'components' =&gt; [
        'swooleHttpServer' =&gt; [
            'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Server\HttpServer::class,
            'host' =&gt; '127.0.0.1',
            'port' =&gt; 9501,
            'documentRoot' =&gt; __DIR__ . '/../web',
            'settings' =&gt; [
                'max_coroutine' =&gt; 100000,
                'log_level' =&gt; SWOOLE_LOG_WARNING,
            ],
            'dispatcher' =&gt; new \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Server\RequestDispatcher(
                __DIR__ . '/web.php'
            ),
        ],
    ],
];
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-修改-web-配置">3. 修改 Web 配置</h3>
<p>编辑 <code>config/web.php</code>，在 <code>return $config;</code> 之前添加：</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">// 合并 Swoole 配置
$swooleConfig = require __DIR__ . '/swoole.php';
$config = \yii\helpers\ArrayHelper::merge($swooleConfig, $config);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-启动服务器">4. 启动服务器</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">php yii swoole/start
</code></pre>
<p>访问 <code>http://127.0.0.1:9501</code> 即可！</p>
<p>停止服务器：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">php yii swoole/stop
# 或按 Ctrl+C
</code></pre>
<h2 id="进阶功能">进阶功能</h2>
<h3 id="数据库连接池">数据库连接池</h3>
<p>在 <code>config/swoole.php</code> 中添加：</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">'db' =&gt; [
    'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Db\CoroutineDbConnection::class,
    'dsn' =&gt; 'mysql:host=127.0.0.1;dbname=your_database',
    'username' =&gt; 'root',
    'password' =&gt; '',
    'charset' =&gt; 'utf8mb4',
    'poolMaxActive' =&gt; 20,
    'poolWaitTimeout' =&gt; 5.0,
],
</code></pre>
<p>使用方式与标准 Yii2 完全相同，连接池自动管理。</p>
<h3 id="redis-连接池">Redis 连接池</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">composer require yiisoft/yii2-redis
</code></pre>
<p>在 <code>config/swoole.php</code> 中添加：</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">'redis' =&gt; [
    'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Redis\CoroutineRedisConnection::class,
    'hostname' =&gt; '127.0.0.1',
    'port' =&gt; 6379,
    'poolMaxActive' =&gt; 20,
    'poolWaitTimeout' =&gt; 5.0,
],

'cache' =&gt; [
    'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Cache\CoroutineRedisCache::class,
    'redis' =&gt; 'redis',
],

'session' =&gt; [
    'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Session\CoroutineSession::class,
    'redis' =&gt; 'redis',
],
</code></pre>
<h3 id="异步队列">异步队列</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">composer require yiisoft/yii2-queue
</code></pre>
<p>配置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">'bootstrap' =&gt; [
    // ...
    'queue',
],
'components' =&gt; [
    'queue' =&gt; [
        'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Queue\CoroutineRedisQueue::class,
        'redis' =&gt; 'redis',
        'channel' =&gt; 'queue',
        'concurrency' =&gt; 10,
    ],
],
</code></pre>
<p>创建任务 <code>jobs/EmailJob.php</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">&lt;?php
namespace app\jobs;

class EmailJob extends \yii\base\BaseObject implements \yii\queue\JobInterface
{
    public $to;
    public $subject;
    
    public function execute($queue)
    {
        // 发送邮件
        \Yii::$app-&gt;mailer-&gt;compose()
            -&gt;setTo($this-&gt;to)
            -&gt;setSubject($this-&gt;subject)
            -&gt;send();
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>使用：</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">Yii::$app-&gt;queue-&gt;push(new EmailJob([
    'to' =&gt; 'user@example.com',
    'subject' =&gt; '测试',
]));
</code></pre>
<h3 id="协程-http-客户端">协程 HTTP 客户端</h3>
<p>配置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">'httpClient' =&gt; [
    'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\HttpClient\CoroutineClient::class,
    'transport' =&gt; [
        'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\HttpClient\CoroutineTransport::class,
    ],
],
</code></pre>
<p>使用：</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">// 单个请求
$response = Yii::$app-&gt;httpClient-&gt;get('https://api.example.com/users')-&gt;send();

// 批量并发请求
$requests = [
    'users' =&gt; Yii::$app-&gt;httpClient-&gt;get('https://api.example.com/users'),
    'posts' =&gt; Yii::$app-&gt;httpClient-&gt;get('https://api.example.com/posts'),
];
$responses = Yii::$app-&gt;httpClient-&gt;batchSend($requests);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="完整配置">完整配置</h2>
<p><code>config/swoole.php</code> 示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">&lt;?php

return [
    'bootstrap' =&gt; [
        [
            'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Bootstrap::class,
            'componentId' =&gt; 'swooleHttpServer',
        ],
        'queue',
    ],
    'components' =&gt; [
        'swooleHttpServer' =&gt; [
            'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Server\HttpServer::class,
            'host' =&gt; '127.0.0.1',
            'port' =&gt; 9501,
            'documentRoot' =&gt; __DIR__ . '/../web',
            'dispatcher' =&gt; new \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Server\RequestDispatcher(__DIR__ . '/web.php'),
        ],
        'db' =&gt; [
            'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Db\CoroutineDbConnection::class,
            'dsn' =&gt; 'mysql:host=127.0.0.1;dbname=myapp',
            'username' =&gt; 'root',
            'password' =&gt; '',
            'poolMaxActive' =&gt; 20,
        ],
        'redis' =&gt; [
            'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Redis\CoroutineRedisConnection::class,
            'hostname' =&gt; '127.0.0.1',
            'poolMaxActive' =&gt; 20,
        ],
        'cache' =&gt; [
            'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Cache\CoroutineRedisCache::class,
            'redis' =&gt; 'redis',
        ],
        'session' =&gt; [
            'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Session\CoroutineSession::class,
            'redis' =&gt; 'redis',
        ],
        'queue' =&gt; [
            'class' =&gt; \Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Queue\CoroutineRedisQueue::class,
            'redis' =&gt; 'redis',
        ],
    ],
];
</code></pre>
<h2 id="常见问题">常见问题</h2>
<p><strong>代码修改后不生效？</strong><br>
重启服务器：<code>Ctrl+C</code> 停止后重新启动（Swoole 常驻内存）</p>
<p><strong>无法启动？</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>检查 Swoole 是否安装：<code>php --ri swoole</code></li>
<li>检查端口占用：<code>lsof -i:9501</code></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>连接超时？</strong><br>
增加 <code>poolMaxActive</code> 和 <code>poolWaitTimeout</code> 参数</p>
<p><strong>静态文件 404？</strong><br>
确认 <code>documentRoot</code> 指向正确的 <code>web</code> 目录</p>
<h2 id="生产部署">生产部署</h2>
<h3 id="systemd-服务">Systemd 服务</h3>
<p>创建 <code>/etc/systemd/system/yii2-app.service</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-ini">[Unit]
Description=Yii2 Swoole
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=www-data
WorkingDirectory=/var/www/my-app
ExecStart=/usr/bin/php /var/www/my-app/yii swoole/start
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
</code></pre>
<p>启动：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable yii2-app
sudo systemctl start yii2-app
</code></pre>
<h3 id="nginx-反向代理">Nginx 反向代理</h3>
<pre><code class="language-nginx">server {
    listen 80;
    server_name example.com;
    
    location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:9501;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="注意事项">注意事项</h2>
<ul>
<li>⚠️ 避免使用全局变量（多请求共享）</li>
<li>⚠️ 使用协程安全组件（CoroutineSession、CoroutineUser）</li>
<li>⚠️ 代码修改需要重启服务器</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="了解更多">了解更多</h2>
<ul>
<li>项目主页：<a href="https://github.com/dacheng-php/yii2-swoole" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/dacheng-php/yii2-swoole</a></li>
<li>示例代码：查看 <code>examples/</code> 目录</li>
<li>Swoole 文档：<a href="https://wiki.swoole.com/zh-cn/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://wiki.swoole.com/zh-cn/</a></li>
</ul>
